name: Brohk
body:
The Brohk methodology was named for a lizardfolk who quit his life as a soldier to become an s-class investigator. Practitioners of this methodology are tougher and more combat savvy than other s-class investigators.

Hit Dice and Base Attack

An investigator with the brohk methodology has a d10 Hit Die and base attack bonus equal to her investigator level.

Impulsiveness

Instead of relying on raw intellect, the investigator trusts his own cunning and force of personality to resolve situations. He uses his Charisma in place of Intelligence to determine his inspiration, studied combat, and studied strike. If his second methodology uses Intelligence, the investigator’s impulsiveness applies there as well.

Bonus Feat

At 4th level, the investigator gains a bonus combat feat. He must meet the prerequisites for that feat.
